يتدافعوا (form VI)
# يَتَدَافَعُوا (yatadāfaʕū) /ja.ta.daː.fa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
# يُتَدَافَعُوا (yutadāfaʕū) /ju.ta.daː.fa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
